text:
Tia: Heads-up — noticed SDKs and the CLI disagree on which API key env var wins. CLI prefers REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT, Python SDK prefers REDWOOD_API_KEY_ORG, node sdk falls back to REDWOOD_API_KEY. This is causing onboarding friction for partner sample apps.

Kevin: ugh, that's bad. Do we have a canonical priority anywhere?

Jordan: Not formally. Historically we added per-project key (REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT) for sandboxing but then org-level keys were used more widely. SDKs drifted.

Maria: +1 to a formalized order. Proposal from me: (1) explicit per-request key (passed to client), (2) REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT, (3) REDWOOD_API_KEY_ORG, (4) REDWOOD_API_KEY. Also env var names must be identical across SDKs/CLI.

Tia: I like that. Also we should document rotation behavior: if the env var changes at runtime, CLI should pick it up on next command, SDKs should re-read env if client constructed with default and we detect auth error and re-init.

Kevin: For SDKs, automatic re-read is risky. We should retry once on 401 with a background re-read of env and one reconnection attempt, then surface an auth error. Implement backoff to avoid tight loops.

Jordan: Example pseudo for SDKs:
```js
// env priority
const key = explicitKey || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY_ORG || process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY;
// on 401: try once after re-reading env
```
This keeps behavior deterministic and simple.

Maria: CLI behavior: respect same priority, and print a deprecation warning if using REDWOOD_API_KEY (global) when project-level key exists. Add `redwood auth status` to show which var is active (but never print the secret, just which var name).

Tia: We should also provide a small sample app change for the quickstart: show how to prefer explicit key in dev, but show how to set project key in CI/CD. Add a short migration snippet for customers.

Kevin: Action items:
- @Jordan: tech spec for env priority and SDK retry semantics (due EOD Thursday)
- @Maria: CLI PR to unify names + `auth status` UX (start today)
- @Tia: update quickstart sample + migration notes (WIP)
- dev-bot: create tracking ticket in DX board when PRs are ready :robot_face:

Maria: quick note — let's also standardize names in all README examples and in terraform modules. Found one repo using `REDWOOD_KEY` lol.

Jordan: will include a grep across repos in the spec.

dev-bot: Created DX-4217 "Unify API key env var priority across SDKs & CLI" and linked this thread.

Tia: thanks everyone. If we agree I'll open a short RFC doc and ping infra/security for key rotation guidance (KMS/HSM implications). :thumbsup:
